blogs.title: Dal Soup Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए दाल का सूप पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
I have shared two versions of this soup. A clear one and a thick one. For younger babies, you can feed dal clear soup. But maha doesn’t like the clear soup. So I puree the whole dal with all the ingredients added and make it thick and creamy. She loves it that way.

 

Things to remember when making soups:

1)Always wash your dal really well.

2)You can use any veggies of your choice in this soup. 

3)You can feed this soup in the evening, this makes a light before dinner meal for your baby.

4)If your baby needs some taste in their food, you can add some salt too.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to Make Dal Soup:

Ingredients:

Toor Dal / Tuvaram paruppu – 2 tablespoon

Turmeric Powder / Manjal Podi – 1/4 teaspoon

Garlic – 1 fat clove peeled

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – a pinch

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1/2 teaspoon

Water – 1 cup

Method:

Wash Toor dal really well. Now take it in a pressure cooker along with all ingredients and cook for 4 whistles.

 

Now turn off the heat and let the steam go all by itself.

Open the cooker.

Now for dal clear soup, you can strain the dal in a sieve. The strained liquid is dal clear soup. You can feed that too babies less than 6 months. Pour it in a sterilized feeding bottle and feed your baby.

For Dal soup, take the strained dal in a mixer and add some of the cooking liquid to it. Puree till smooth. Pour this into bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Guava Puree Recipe for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए अमरूद प्यूरी रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Guava is very good in vitamin C and helps to improve the immune system. This makes a great baby food too.

 

Things to remember:

 

1)The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth.   

2)Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3)In my opinion and experience, guava won't cause any constipation in babies. I feed this puree once a week. 

4) I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. 

5)Remove the seeds from the guava completely. 

6)Cooking the guava before feeding makes digestion easy.

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls:  

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Steamed Mashed Banana:

Take ripe guava. It has to be fresh and ripe. Peel them and cut the cheeks of them.

Use a spoon to scoop the seeds from them.

Now take all the flesh in a saucepan, add a splash of water and cover it and simmer for 5 mins or till it is cooked.

Pierce with a knife to see whether it is cooked. If you go in easily then it is cooked.

Put them in a blender and puree them. You can add some clean water to adjust the consistency.

Pour this into sterilized clean bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Custard Apple (Sitaphal) Milkshake Recipe
blogs.title_hi: कस्टर्ड सेब (सीताफल) मिल्कशेक रेसिपी
blogs.content:
I have never heard about this milkshake until my sister mentioned this. She told me that she feeds her baby this milkshake and it tastes really yummy too. During our last shopping hubby picked a few custard apples which were lying in the fridge. We normally eat them like it, it is such a pain to remove the seeds from the flesh. So when I wanted to make a milkshake out of it, The result was a creamy glassful of a delicious drink. 

 

You can feed this to your baby too, this milkshake can be started after 6 months, but don't add cow’s milk until your baby is 1 year..instead add breast milk or formula milk or simply leave it out.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Makes: 1 glass

 

Ingredients:

Custard Apple / Sitaphal – 1 Ripe

Sugar – 1 tablespoon

Cold Milk – 1 cup

 

Method:

Crack open a custard apple, scoop the flesh from it, take it in a blender, add in 1/4 cup of milk and pulse it a few times this will remove the flesh from the seeds.

Now remove the seeds from the mixer jar.

Add sugar and more milk. Grind till it is frothy.

Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

blogs.title: Apple Sticks with Homemade Peanut Butter Recipe
blogs.title_hi: ऐप्पल स्टिक होममेड पीनट बटर रेसिपी के साथ
blogs.content:
My baby food section is a total hit. I have started giving normal foods. Many of my viewers have been asking me to share some finger food ideas for babies. So I have started this series from today. So keep looking for new food ideas.

Some people may think about peanut allergies, but feeding peanuts to babies below 1 year is not advisable. But you can slowly introduce peanuts after 1 year, but I kind of stayed away from it till now and started now. I don't want to give her whole peanuts, so made this peanut butter and gave her. I made apples as a finger and dipped it in peanut butter and gave her. She liked it.

You can give this to babies above 1.5 years.

 

Preparation Time : 15 mins

Makes : 250 grams

 

Ingredients:

Roasted Whole Peanuts – 250 grams

Powdered Palm Sugar / Jaggery – 3 tablespoon

Salt – 1/4 tsp

Oil – 2 tablespoon

Green Apples, Red Apples

Method:

Take peanuts in a blender, powder them into a powder.

 

Continue blending till oil comes from it, add in jaggery, salt and blend till smooth.

Now add in 1 tablespoon of oil and puree till smooth. Now add in another tablespoon of oil and puree till smooth.

Cut apples into thick slices and cut into finger-like strips. 

Serve with apple sticks.

blogs.title: Mini Potato Paratha Recipe, Finger Food Ideas for Babies
blogs.title_hi: मिनी आलू पराठा रेसिपी, शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड आइडियाज
blogs.content:
Paratha is a great food for babies. Not for little ones, I started feeding paratha when maha was 15 months. I made soft paratha and chapatis, tore it into small pieces. Since it is so soft Kid loves it so much.

There are so many different parathas which you can make for your baby. To make colorful paratha, add some carrot juice or beetroot juice into the wheat flour instead of water. So it is more nutritious for your baby.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 20 to 25 mins for cooking potato / 1 to 2 mins per paratha

Makes : 3 to 4 small paratha

 

Ingredients:

 

For Dough:

Wheat Flour – 1/2 cup

Salt a pinch

Water as needed

 

For Filling:

Potato – 1 medium size boiled

Salt a pinch

Pepper optional

Ghee for frying paratha

 

Method:

Take dough ingredients in a bowl and make a soft dough. Cover and let it rest.

Mash potato with some salt and pepper. Divide it into two balls.

Take one ball, flatten it out, place a ball in the middle, cover it up, roll it into a thick paratha.

Put it in hot Tawa and cook on both sides till done. Apply ghee as needed.

Tear it into small pieces and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Bread Butter and Jam Recipe, Finger Food Ideas for Babies
blogs.title_hi: ब्रेड बटर और जैम रेसिपी, शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड आइडियाज
blogs.content:
This is a recipe that is not even a recipe, but I just want to share it with you all because it makes great finger food for babies and this is just to give you an idea. So try this out, and this is not only for babies, it makes a great breakfast for adults as well.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Makes: 1 sandwich

 

Ingredients:

Bread as needed

Butter as needed

Jam as needed

 

Method:

Take a bread slice, spread butter generously over it, then spread jam over it. Sandwich it together.

Cut the edges, then cut into slices or strips.

Use a squeezy bottle to make designs over the sandwich.

blogs.title: Healthy Biscuits Recipe for Babies, Teething Biscuits, Finger Food for Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों के लिए स्वस्थ बिस्कुट पकाने की विधि, शुरुआती बिस्कुट, शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड
blogs.content:
Many of you have been asking to share baby teething biscuit recipe, Somedays I like to make some homemade cookies or biscuits for her. For babies, it is not recommended to add any raising agents like baking soda or powder. So it is best to go for a shortbread kind of cookies.

One day I thought of making wheat cookies with ghee. First, I thought of adding jaggery in the cookies, but I was confused that if I need to add jaggery it has to be melted and strained. So I was not sure whether that liquid will make a perfect cookie. So I thought of adding panangkarkandu which is also called rock sugar. I added some ginger powder for flavor and the cookies turned out brilliant.

I hope you will give this a try and not only your baby, you too can enjoy this healthy and tasty one.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 12 to 14 mins

Makes: 20 Biscuits

 

Ingredients:

 

Wheat Flour / Atta – 1 cup

Rock Sugar / Panangkarkandu – 1/2 cup Powdered

Ghee – 1/4 cup

Dry Ginger Powder / Chukku Podi – 1/2 tsp

Milk – 2 to 3 tablespoon

 

(MY 1 CUP MEASURES 240 ML)

 

Method:

 

Preheat oven to 180 degrees C.

Take ghee and sugar in a bowl. Mix well. Add in milk and mix well till creamy.

Now add in dry ginger powder and mix well.

Add in flour and knead to a dough. Add milk if needed.

Now roll this between two sheets of plastic wrap.

Trim off the edges and cut into strips.

Remove it carefully using a spatula and place on a foil-lined baking sheet.

Bake it for 12 to 14 mins till golden. It will be soft when you take from oven, it will harden as it cools down.

Let it cool completely. Now store this in an airtight container for a week.

blogs.title: Egg Kuzhi Paniyaram Recipe, Finger food Recipe Ideas for Toddlers and Babies
blogs.title_hi: अंडा कुज़ी पनियारम रेसिपी, टॉडलर्स और शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड रेसिपी आइडियाज़
blogs.content:
I made this egg paniyaram a few days back. Before adding the seasoning I too some batter and added only salt and pepper to that and made few paniyaram..Everyone loved it. I thought of sharing it as a separate post so you can find it under finger food for babies..Hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turned out for you..

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time: 2 to 3 mins per batch

Serves: 2 to 3 

 

Ingredients:

Idli or Dosa Batter – 2 cup

Egg – 2

Oil or Ghee for frying 

Freshly Crushed Black Pepper – to taste

Salt to taste

 

Method:

Take eggs in a blender and blend till it is whipped.

Now take dosa batter in a bowl, add eggs, salt, pepper in it and mix well.

Heat paniyaram pan with some oil. Pour a handful of batter in and cook till golden on both sides on low heat.

Serve.

blogs.title: Avocado Puree Recipe for Babies ( Mashed Avocado )
blogs.title_hi: एवोकैडो प्यूरी पकाने की विधि शिशुओं के लिए (मसला हुआ एवोकैडो)
blogs.content:
Avocado is a great first food for babies. You can start feeding it as soon as your baby starts their solids. Since it is easy to digest, they are great weaning food. Avocado is rich in omega 3 which helps in brain development in babies. You can add some banana to this puree, it adds potassium too. 

Avocados are high in monounsaturated fat, that’s the good kind of fat! A medium-sized avocado contains approximately 322 calories and up to 30 grams of fat – WOW. 1 cup of avocado puree contains almost 700 calories as it would take approximately 2 avocados to make a cup. The benefits of avocados far outweigh the “risks”. You can read more about the benefits of avocado here

 

Things to remember:

1. The texture of the puree depends upon you, I would recommend you to make the puree smooth for smaller babies. 

2. Your baby won't empty the whole bowl all at once, start with few spoons then increase it gradually as days pass by.

3. In my opinion & experience avocado won't cause any constipation in babies. I feed this puree once a week. 

4. I don’t prefer freezing purees. I make it fresh every day. 

5. Avocado is filled with omega 3, so it is very healthy for babies.

6. Avocado is easily digestible and makes a great first solid food or weaning food for baby.

7. You can skip adding sugar to this puree if your baby likes it plain. 

 

How to sterilize baby feeding bowls: 

 

Start by sterilizing the bowls and spoons which you are going to feed your baby. Take the bowl and spoon in a large saucepan, cover it with water and bring them to a boil. Boil it rapidly for 5 mins. Now you can turn the heat off and leave them to stay in the hot water till use. 

 

How to make Mashed Avocado:

Take a ripe avocado. It has to be fresh and ripe. Cut them in half and remove the seed.

Use a spoon to scoop the flesh from them.

Now take all the flesh in a bowl and mash it well using a fork or spoon or masher.

You can even put them in a blender and puree them.  

Now add sugar to taste and mix well.

Pour this into sterilized clean bowls and feed your baby.

blogs.title: Sooji Potato Pancakes Recipe, Finger Food Recipes for Toddlers and Babies
blogs.title_hi: सूजी पोटैटो पैनकेक रेसिपी, टॉडलर्स और शिशुओं के लिए फिंगर फूड रेसिपी
blogs.content:
This is one recipe that I came up with when I wanted to feed my little one with some snacks in the evening. I had a boiled potato on hand, so I added some sooji and made it into the pancake. It turned out so soft, so it will be easy for your little one to chew. Plus it is so tasty.

 

Preparation Time; 10 mins

Cooking Time: 1 to 2 mins per batch

Makes: 10 mini pancakes

 

Ingredients:

Potato – 1 boiled, peeled and mashed

Sooji / Rava / Semolina – 1 cup

Water – 1/2 cup or as needed

Salt to taste

Spring Onions – 3 tablespoons finely chopped

Carrots or Beetroots – 1/4 cup grated

Ghee or Oil for making pancakes

 

Method:

Take mashed potatoes in a bowl, add water, sooji, salt, and mix well. Add in carrots and spring onions. Mix well., Set this batter aside for 10 mins.

Heat oil or ghee in a non-stick pan and make mini pancakes.

Cook for a few minutes on one side., flip over and cook on another side.

Remove to a plate and serve

blogs.title: Eggless Nutella, French Toast Sticks Recipe ( Egg Option is also Included)
blogs.title_hi: एगलेस नुटेला, फ्रेंच टोस्ट स्टिक्स रेसिपी (एग ऑप्शन भी शामिल है)
blogs.content:
I spread some Nutella over the bread and coated it with an eggless custard mix and fried it. It was delicious. Instead of the custard powder mix, you can use egg coating as well. 

I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Cooking Time: 2 to 3 mins

Serves: 2

 

Ingredients:

 

Bread Slices – 4 to 6

Nutella – 3 tablespoon or as needed

Unsalted Butter – 2 tablespoon

 

For Eggless French Toast Coating: 

Custard Powder – 2 tablespoon

Sugar – 1.5 tablespoon

Milk – 1/2 cup

Vanilla Essence – 1/2 tsp

 

OR

 

For Egg French Toast Coating:

Egg – 1 

Sugar – 1 tablespoon

Milk – 1/2 cup

Vanilla Essence – 1 tsp

 

Method:

Take bread slices, cut the crust off, spread 1.5 tablespoons of Nutella onto each slice and spread it evenly. Now cover with another slice and cut it into fingers or sticks.

Mix all the ingredients given for coating. 

Melt butter in a pan for frying.

Take each stick and dip in the coating, put it over the butter and fry them for 2 to 3 mins till golden on both sides, cook on low heat.

Remove and cool little and serve.

blogs.title: Instant Badam Milk Powder Recipe for Babies and Toddlers
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं और बच्चों के लिए झटपट बादम मिल्क पाउडर रेसिपी
blogs.content:
It is tasty, healthy and homemade which is great for kids and toddlers. For sweetness I added palm sugar in this, you can use sugar as well. And the main thing is, don't over grind after you add badam, else it will turn into a paste.

I hope you will give this a try and not only your baby, you too can enjoy this healthy and tasty one.

 

Preparation Time: 15 mins

Baking Time: 15 to 20 mins

Makes: 1 cup of powder

 

Ingredients:

Badam / Almonds – 1 cup

Panangkarkandu / Palm Sugar Candy – 1/3 cup or as needed

Cardamom – 6 to 8

Saffron a good pinch

Turmeric Powder / Manjal Podi – 1 tsp

 

Method:

Preheat oven to 160 degrees C.

 

Take almonds in a sauce pan, cover with water, heat it and bring it to a boil. Once it boils, take it off the heat and set aside for 5 mins. Now drain it and wash it with cold water. Now squeeze and remove the skin. Pat the almonds dry with a paper towel. 

Now put the almonds in a pan and roast it for 15 mins. Remove it cool it completely.

Now take cardamom, saffron, turmeric powder, palm sugar in a blender and powder it. Now add in the cooled almonds and powder it once. 

 

DONT OVER GRIND IT, ELSE IT WILL TURN INTO A PASTE.

 

Now remove to a bowl and cool little. Now pour this in a bottle and store it in the fridge.

When you want to have it, just add a tablespoon of the powder in a cup and pour boiled milk or warm milk over it and mix well.

Serve immediately.

blogs.title: Banana Oatmeal Recipe for Breakfast, Caramelized Banana Oats Recipe
blogs.title_hi: केला ओटमील रेसिपी ब्रेकफास्ट के लिए, केरामाइज्ड केले ओट्स रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Recently I have been having oatmeal in my breakfast a lot. I try to add some fruits into the oatmeal and make it more tasty and enjoyable. This is one recipe that I made yesterday and loved it, so with no more delay I am sharing it.

I used some ripe bananas and for sweetener, I used jaggery in this. You can add brown sugar or honey for sweetener. Stay tuned I will be sharing much more oatmeal recipes soon.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Cooking Time: 10 mins

Serves: 2

 

Ingredients:

Regular Milk or Soy Milk – 2 cup

Instant Quick Cooking Oats – 1/2 cup

Cinnamon – 1/2 tsp

Brown Sugar or Jaggery – 1 tablespoon or to taste

 

For Topping:

Ripe Banana – 1 sliced

Brown Sugar / Jaggery – 1 tablespoon

Butter – 1 tsp

 

Method:

 

Start by making the caramel. Heat butter in a pan, add in sliced bananas and brown sugar and saute till for 3 to 4 mins till caramelized. Remove this to a bowl and set aside.

Now in the same pan, add in oats, soy milk, cinnamon, and brown sugar and mix well. Cook till oats are done. 

Now spoon this into a bowl and top with bananas. Serve.

blogs.title: Roasted Carrot Chews Recipe for Kids and Toddlers
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों और बच्चों के लिए भुनी हुई गाजर की चटनी
blogs.content:
This is my latest addiction, I made this for baby and they loved it to the core. More than them I loved it so much. It is sweet and well browned and so good. Great for little ones. Instead of boiled carrots, give them this. It is tasty and nutritious and really yummy.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Baking Time: 25 to 30 mins

Serves: 2

 

Ingredients:

 

Carrots – 3 to 4 large

Salt to taste

Olive Oil or any Cooking Oil – 1 tsp

 

Method:

 

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Peel and wash carrots, slice it into long strips. 

Take it in a bowl, season with salt and oil and toss well.

Spoon this into baking pan and bake for 25 to 30 mins till the carrots are cooked and roasted to your liking. 

Remove it and cool it well. 

Serve to your kids or enjoy yourselves.

blogs.title: Egg Noodles for Kids and Toddlers
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों और बच्चों के लिए अंडा नूडल्स
blogs.content:
This recipe is very easy to make and taste so yummy. If your kids love pasta, you can make a simple tomato sauce and toss these noodles in that sauce and give. They will love it for sure. Eggs are rich in protein. I make egg dosa, some days I make egg mini cups in which I add lots of veggies, will share that soon..Most of the day it is these noodles.

 

Preparation Time: 2 min

Cooking Time: 2 to 3 mins

 

Ingredients:

 

Egg – 1 or 2 

Turmeric Powder – a pinch (optional)

Salt to taste

Butter as needed

 

Method:

 

Crack an open egg in a bowl, add in salt and turmeric and whisk it well.

Now heat butter in a nonstick pan, pour the egg mix in and swirl to coat the pan in a thin layer.

Now lower the heat and cook till the top of the egg sets.

Now remove it to a plate and roll it tightly.

Now slice it thinly to resemble noodles.

Serve to your kids.

blogs.title: Baked Potato Fries Recipe for Kids and Toddler
blogs.title_hi: बेक्ड आलू फ्राइ रेसिपी फॉर किड्स एंड टॉडलर
blogs.content:
Most of the kids love french fries, maha is no exception. She loves it so much. But since it is deep fried I kind of stay away from it, finally I made this baked version. It is so easy to make and turns out crunchy too.

This is a thin version of french fries which needs no parboiling. I will soon share a thicker version. So keep checking it.

I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Baking Time: 15 to 20 mins

Serves: 2

Ingredients:

 

Potato – 1 large

Oil – 1 teaspoon

Salt to taste

 

Method:

 

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C.

Wash and peel a potato, cut it into thin strips and wash it in lots of water. Now drain off the water and let it drain for 5 mins or so.

Now dry it with a paper towel.

Line a baking tray with foil. Place potatoes in it and drizzle oil over it. Now coat it well with oil.

Arrange the potatoes in a single layer and pop it in the oven. Bake for 15 to 20 mins.

Now remove it and scoop the potatoes in a bowl. sprinkle with salt and toss well.

Serve hot.

blogs.title: Carrot Idiyappam Recipe - Carrot Noodles Recipe for Toddlers and Kids
blogs.title_hi: गाजर इडियप्पम रेसिपी - बच्चों और बच्चों के लिए गाजर नूडल्स रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Here I have used carrot juice, you can add beetroot juice in this too. I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Cooking Time : 3 to 5 mins

Serves: 2

 

Ingredients:

Carrot Juice – 1 cup (juice from 3 carrots)

Roasted Rice Flour or Idiyappam Flour – 3/4 cup

Salt to taste

Ghee – 1 teaspoon

 

Method:

Peel and chop carrots, take it in a blender, add little water and make it into a smooth puree. Strain it and extract 1 cup of carrot juice.

Mix rice flour with salt and set aside.

Take carrot juice in a pan, bring it to a boil. Add in rice flour slowly and mix till it forms into a dough.

Now add in ghee and make it into a dough.

Take it in idiyappam press, squeeze it in a greased steamer plate. Steam this for 3 to 4 mins.

Now remove it and cool it, Separate it and serve.

blogs.title: Babies Curd Rice Recipe - Yogurt Rice Recipe for Kids And Babies
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों को दही चावल की रेसिपी - बच्चों और बच्चों के लिए दही चावल की रेसिपी
blogs.content:
The key to making a tasty and kids friendly curd rice or yogurt rice is to add less yogurt and more milk which makes it tastier.

So give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Cooking Time: 20 to 30 mins

Serves : 3 to 4

 

Ingredients:

Rice – 1/2 cup 

Water – 2 to 2.5 cups 

Milk – 1 cup or as needed

Curd / Yogurt – 1.5 tablespoon

Salt to taste

Sugar – 1 tsp

 

For Seasoning:

Ghee –  1 tablespoon

Mustard Seeds / Kaduku – 1 tsp

Urad Dal / Ulundu paruppu – 1 tsp

Asafoetida / Hing / Kaya Podi – 1/4 tsp

Carrot – 1 medium size grated

 

Method:

 

Take rice in a pressure cooker and add water to it. Cook it for 4 to 5 whistles. Simmer for 10 mins.  Switch off the heat and let the pressure go all by itself. Open and mash it up.

 

Now add salt to it and mix well. Add in yogurt and milk and mix well. Add in sugar and mix well

 

Now make tempering. Heat ghee in a frying pan heats it up. Add in mustard, urad dal and asafoetida. Fry it for 30 sec.

 

Add in grated carrots. Saute for 1 min or so.

 

Pour this over the rice and mix well.

 

Enjoy it yourself or serve your Lil one.

blogs.title: Healthy Vegetable Stir Fry Recipe for Kids and Toddlers
blogs.title_hi: बच्चों और बच्चों के लिए हेल्दी वेजिटेबल स्टिर फ्राई रेसिपी
blogs.content:
This is a great dish to include veggies in your little one's diet. You can add whatever veggies you like in this. The addition of nuts powder in this makes it more tasty and healthy for your kids. You can serve this with rice or use it as a filling in paratha or use it as a filling for roti rolls.

 

Preparation Time: 5 mins

Cooking Time: 10 mins

Serves: 2

 

Ingredients:

 

Vegetables of your choice (i used carrots, beans, and spring onions) – 1 cup

Ghee – 2 tsp

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam – 1/2 teaspoon(optional)

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Sugar – 1/4 tsp

Powdered Nuts – 2 tablespoon ( i used cashew, badam and walnuts will work too)

Coriander leaves – 1 tablespoon finely chopped

 

 

Method:

Heat ghee in a pan, add cumin and let them sizzle.

Add in veggies and mix well. Cook them for 5 mins or so.

Add in salt, sugar, and pepper and mix well.

Add in nuts powders and mix well.

Finally, add in coriander leaves and give a good mix.

Serve with rice

blogs.title: Instant Wheat Cerelac Recipe for Babies, Travel Food for Babies
blogs.title_hi: शिशुओं के लिए तत्काल गेहूं सेरेलेक पकाने की विधि, शिशुओं के लिए यात्रा भोजन
blogs.content:
These powders are great to have handy when traveling since they require no cooking you can just add some milk or water and feed your baby. I am sure you will be feeling so happy when you feed your baby with these instead of the packaged stuff. I will try to share many more recipes similar to this for you. So give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Baking Time: 20 mins

Makes: 2 cups of powder

 

Ingredients:

Wheat Flour – 1 cup

Almond Powder – 3 tablespoons ( i used homemade badam milk mix)

Rock Sugar or Panakarkandu – 1/2 cup

Ghee or Melted Butter – 1/4 cup

Milk or Water – 2 tablespoons

 

 

Method:

Preheat oven to 180 degrees C.

Take all ingredients in a bowl and knead to a dough. Add milk if needed.

Now roll this between two sheets of plastic wrap.

Trim off the edges and cut into squares.

Remove it carefully using a spatula and place on a foil-lined baking sheet.

Bake it for 15 to 18 mins till golden. It will be soft when you take from oven, it will harden as it cools down.

 

Let it cool completely.

Now take this in a blender and powder finely.

Now for making cereal, take some powder in a bowl and add hot milk or water and mix till it reaches right texture.

Feed your baby.

 

Notes:

1)This powder can be stored in room temp. But for safety purpose store it in the fridge.

2)You can take this while traveling.

3)Instead of hot water or milk. You can use warm or cold water or milk.

4)Start with little water or milk and add more as per the consistency needed,

5)Instead of making powder, this can be given as biscuits too.

6)If making for babies under 7 months, skip the badam powder.

 

 

This is an instant, No-cook cerelac for baby. You can prepare this cereal a few different ways.

1)You can add warm water or milk to make this cereal. 

2)You can use normal water or milk to make this cereal, in which case the texture will be a little coarse.

3)You can add boiling water or milk to make this cereal, in which case the texture will be so smooth.

4)You can add some powdered jaggery or sugar to this, add some ghee and make ladoo.

5)For making soft-cooked balls. Take this powder in a saucepan, add some milk and mix. Add more sugar or jaggery as needed, add little ghee and cook this on low heat till it comes as a ball. Take a small portion from this and shape it into balls.
